name: crew
description: Run several Claude Code sessions on one working tree and one branch without lost edits: a coordinator/worker playbook, session identity unique across crews on one machine, a one-screen status of every dirty path by owner, crew-tagged hand-off messages, hot-spot holds with an edit guard, a slot queue for machine time (cpu / exclusive / quiet), copies landed with a merge-or-refuse apply, a snapshot before every edit, and layered project/user config. Runtime-free (bash + awk + git).
